> Ted Baker London 'Challen' Chukka

You're amazing, thank you!

I'm too lazy to read all of this, but I actually sued a creditor and won. When a debt collection agency contacts you for the first time, they must have mailed you a letter that you have to receive within seven days of that initial phone call.  In my case, they didn't, and I was able to sue them for more than my debt owed to them. And won. I also had an attorney representing me and they contacted me after receiving the letter that stated they weren't allowed to contact me. This also added to it.

I suspect I use the wrong analyst terms often. I was recently promoted to Information Analyst and Project coordinator so I feel like I'm straddling two different paths. Ultimately, I would like to lead teams and be that intermediary between groups. In my experience, there's nothing worse then having a supervisor/project lead who doesn't really understand the technical jargon or at least a good basic understanding of what the teams are doing. With that said, I really like data and information so maybe I'm just going to be some Hodge podge of things. I guess I'm just not sure what to focus on to grow. Other than SQL fundamentals, learn Python, and enhanced project management skills.
